title: IBSI 2D reference values
description: 2D subset of the reference values published in Chapter 3 of the IBSI reference manual. Values are copied from the rendered tables without numerical modification.

source.document: The image biomarker standardisation initiative - Reference manual
source.citation: Zwanenburg A, Leger S, Vallières M, Löck S. Image biomarker standardisation initiative. arXiv:1612.07003v10.

subset.name: IBSI 2D reference values
subset.definition: Reference values that can be compared with a 2D slice-wise feature extraction pipeline.
inclusionRules: Feature tables in Chapter 3 of the IBSI reference manual.
Texture features: rows whose aggregation method starts with '2D', for the digital phantom and configurations A/B.
Non-texture features: configurations A/B, which the manual defines as 2D slice-wise configurations.
exclusions: Morphological features: the manual defines 25 morphological features in 3D only and provides no 2D reference values.
Digital phantom rows for non-texture features: these tables do not define a 2D aggregation.

nonTextureFeatures.note: These features have no 2D digital-phantom reference values; their 2D values come from the CT configurations A/B. A digital-phantom-only run cannot compare them.

morphologyFeatures.note: The manual defines no 2D morphological reference values.

toleranceRule.withoutTolerance: The manual publishes no tolerance for this row. Report the deviation with status 'no_tolerance' and exclude the row from pass/fail consistency counts.
toleranceRule.note: This rule is pre-registered before the comparison run and does not invent a threshold for rows without a published tolerance.

notes: Codes are not guaranteed to be unique across tables. Use code + name + tableIndex when joining to a feature mapping.
Inclusion in this file does not imply that the RadStudio operator implements the feature; platform mapping is a separate task.
